Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. gymnasium, PyElastica and COOMM were not installed where the gate ran, so the fake backend is the package's own pure-Python point-mass surrogate (fake.py); it was not compared with the upstream environment and the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. The fidelity contract is honestly F0 with its gaps. Five warnings are expected: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only seeds the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the two integer seed inputs, ticks and the action.values array the bridge derives; declaring actions to add units was not done because it exposes reset/step inputs without descriptions and fails G6/G8. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
